status: Installed on one node and one test guest at the user's request, for trying by hand. Not published.

effect.restarted: qsm-pve-direct-terminal and qsm-pve-direct-signal, three times today for exp217, exp218 and exp219, with no console open each time.
effect.unchanged: Boot, VMs 103 and 104, every other CT with its PID and start time, pveproxy and pvedaemon, pve-manager. dpkg audit empty.
effect.not_installed: VM 104 and the other containers have no new guest package.

incidents.cause: The installed-path harness clicked an empty part of the login screen at fixed coordinates. In Firefox the picture lies differently and the click landed on Shut Down, which powers off a container with no confirmation.
incidents.repair: Started again. The harness now masks the power-off targets for its run and logs in with no click once the greeter knows the account.
incidents.lost: The measurement fixture of LXC 108, running since 28 October: its KWin, agent, quality fixture and metadata processes and their files under /run. The ui-bench and clip runs need it recreated, and verify-lxc* need a new baseline. The qualification runs had already finished.

incidents.what: A real login on console 2 and a greeter that covered the KWin fixture, then a stale clip stand, invalidated two measurement chains.
incidents.cause: A check ran on the same guest as the bench, without holding the lane for the whole time, and a chain was stopped by hand.
incidents.repair: Those runs were discarded and repeated. They are in no record.

incidents.what: A desktop session ended about 40 s after a screen lock.
incidents.cause: The container sat at its 4 GiB limit, with 3.2 GiB in a metadata fixture process running the guest package of 28 October (exp68). Memory reclaim held loginctl past 15 s, which ended the seat's control service, and every desktop on both seats with it.
incidents.repair: qsm-native-seat keeps going when logind is slow. A later commit, 285dd2a, fixed metadata leaks. Whether the present version holds its size over days was not measured.

installed_path_check.method: Normal PVE ticket login and console popup on the installed services, no route override. A throwaway account logged in through the real SDDM greeter in the picture, and the session started the helper by itself.
checks_failed: chromium: the temporary file existed during the upload and is gone
installed_path_check.failure_note: The harness's sampler looked for the temporary file during a 40 MiB upload, which now ends between two samples. No temporary file remained. The check now asks only that.
covered: A helper started by qsm-session-launch in a real login, running as the account, with its parents back to the session
A real screen locker: kscreenlocker engaged by loginctl lock-session. New folder and browsing are refused with the page's message, a copy pauses, and continues whole after unlock-session
Chromium and Firefox through PVE, with the console on TURN over TCP 8006 and files on their own WebSocket on TCP 8006
The file peer runs as nobody
40 MiB each way with SHA-256 equal, new folder, rename, delete, and in Firefox a folder as one tar

not_checked: A VM through a real PVE console with Display1. VMs ran on a stand with the real agent and virtio port, without PVE.
qsm-desktop-agent-setup and the systemd user unit on a real guest
A real folder picker dialog, which automation replaces with the origin private file system
The console embedded in the PVE page. Only the popup ran.
A real PVE user without the file privileges. Refusals are unit-tested only, as the node has only root@pam.
A Mac, a phone, a tablet, macOS and Windows guests

rollback.where: /root/qsm-exp219-install-20261107/rollback on the node, which holds exp216, the published version
steps: Reload the PVE page with cache bypass and reopen consoles

user_steps: Reload the PVE page with cache bypass, open the console of CT 108 and log in with an account of your own. For a VM guest, install /root/qsm-exp219-install-20261107/qsm-desktop-agent_0.4.0+stock4.14~exp219_amd64.deb in it and run qsm-desktop-agent-setup USER.

more_guests.requested: The user asked for CT 105 and VM 103 as well, after keeping Shut Down on the login screen. exp220, which removed it, was built and never installed; b773536 is reverted by 3db4634.

ct_105.installed: qsm-console-guest and qsm-qt-input-geometry 0.4.0+stock4.14~exp219, with six Qt 6 libraries from the Ubuntu archive
ct_105.restarted: Nothing. Sway, SDDM, the seat services and both login screens kept their processes from 17 and 26 October. No one was logged in.
ct_105.takes_effect: The file helper starts at the next desktop login. The seat daemon fix needs a restart of qsm-native-seat-control@N, done at the next container restart.
ct_105.backup: /root/qsm-before-exp219-20261107.tar.gz in the container: /etc/qsm-direct and /usr/lib/qsm-console as they were
ct_105.not_checked: A login and a file transfer

vm_103.restarted: qsm-desktop-agent@dima, so that the new binary forwards files. dima's desktop session stayed. The file helper was started in that session.
vm_103.checked_from_the_node: FS_CAPS answers OK FS_CAPS 1. A read-only file session's hello came back from the helper as dima, home /home/dima, locked true, since that screen was locked. The session was closed at once.
vm_103.not_started: qsm-desktop-metadata, which this package adds, starts at the next login.
vm_103.not_checked: A transfer through the console. That would have opened a console on a desktop in use.

node_update_exp221.restarted: qsm-pve-direct-terminal and qsm-pve-direct-signal, with no console open

node_update_exp221.checked: Firefox on the local stand: a downloaded file is listed on this side and can be sent back to the guest. The Firefox scenarios pass. Not run through PVE.
